description: This file implements the GpxLocationsHandler class, which processes GPS location data from GPX files, parses the data, and sends it via a GNSS client over a gRPC channel. It includes methods for handling messages, parsing GPS coordinates, and establishing communication with a GNSS server.

classes.name: GpxLocationsHandler
classes.description: A handler class responsible for processing GPX location messages, parsing GPS coordinates, and communicating with a GNSS server.

methods.name: GpxLocationsHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler with a callback to send data to the client.

methods.name: HandleMessage
methods.description: Processes incoming GPS data messages, parses the coordinates, and sends them to the GNSS client.
